% algorithm2e's line numbers at the right (rightnl), as in the PDF: each
% the same distance from the text's right edge, also in a block and on the
% line of an until.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[ruled,vlined,linesnumbered,rightnl]{algorithm2e}
\begin{document}
\begin{algorithm}[H]
\caption{Binary search}\label{alg:search}
\KwIn{a sorted array $a_1 \le \dots \le a_n$ and a value $x$}
$\ell \gets 1$, $h \gets n + 1$\tcp*{the answer lies between them}
\While{$\ell < h$}{
  $m \gets \lfloor (\ell + h)/2 \rfloor$\;
  \eIf{$a_m < x$}{
    $\ell \gets m + 1$\;
  }{
    $h \gets m$\;
  }
}
\Repeat{no vertex is marked}{
  remove the marked vertices\;
}
\Return{the index}\label{line:return}\;
\end{algorithm}
Line~\ref{line:return} returns the index.
\end{document}
